quest.title: The Proud "Beret Society"
quest.description: Through your conversation, you learn of an organization known as the "Beret Society" that provides support for prisoners who feel helpless and lonely. Wriothesley suggests that you come with him and take a look at their daily lives.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

chapter.title: Reborn in the Land of Grievances

talks.objective: Go to the Beret Society's gathering place

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: We are honored by your visit, Your Grace. All of us at the Society have been waiting for your arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Are these two your guests?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: #Mm-hmm. Let me introduce you to them. {NICKNAME}, this is Dougier, the head of the Beret Society. This is their gathering place.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Members can find all sorts of drinks and snacks here, as well as a large variety of books and other resources.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Every once in a while, the Society will also host activities and seminars, which are always well-attended.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: You flatter me, Your Grace. All we did was set up an organization in the same way as you would in the world above.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: It's so easy to feel lonely and helpless when you arrive here for the first time. I remember that feeling all too well. None of us knew anything about this place then, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: But that's when the thought came to me. If we could help everyone turn over a new leaf, they would no longer have to lead such gloomy existences.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Thus, it was with your help that I founded the Beret Society.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you were also involved with this, Wriothesley?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, my part in this was minimal. All I did was follow procedure and rubber stamp the application.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'm sure you have a very good sense of what this place is about by now. As you know, not everyone takes their sentence seriously — for some, this is just another place where they can eat, breathe, and sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: But the Society is a great place for those who wish to turn things around.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Exactly right. Here, we'll keep an eye on each other, and remind each other of our goals. Everyone can focus on rehabilitating our mental states, and even make many new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Our operations are entirely funded by members' donated goods and Credit Coupons. Same for the things you see here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who knew you could find such a place in the Fortress of Meropide...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right, and what's the deal with the hats?

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Ah, there's nothing deep about it. I just felt like we needed some kind of visible identifier.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: If our members felt joy and pride from being a part of this group, then the hats would become a point of pride for them as well.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: And when we're together, we will feel a sense of community from seeing everyone's hats.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Optimism, community, hard work, and a desire for a new life... I hope this hat will show everyone everything we have been working towards.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: In other words, that hat has come to represent something like a model citizen, which also helps them recruit new members.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Once again, you are exactly right, Your Grace. That's a part of our goal as well. Let's take a little 'ol seat over here — there's no need for us to stand.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: I'll ask the members to get us some drinks. Please wait just one moment. Feel free to look around, too, if you want to learn more about us.

choices.text: So, this meeting was planned all along?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! What happened to your slow day, Wriothesley?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Seems like I shouldn't underestimate an adventurer's keen sense of observation. I'll bear that in mind the next time I need to do something low key...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Kidding of course. We're just discussing some small matters. It shouldn't take long.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: We've also already gone over the organization's vision. Instead of listening to me try to explain some more, maybe it'd be better if you took a look around for yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why does Paimon feel like he didn't answer the question at all... Eh. Well, we're already here, aren't we?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, might as well take a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, they're supposed to be like, the model prisoners, right? So this is what their spot looks like...

choices.text: He said they had been waiting for a while...

talks.objective: Chat with the members of the Beret Society

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, what are you doing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Oh, hello, you are guests of the Duke, are you not? I'm organizing the bookshelves. Want to take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: We've got some classics, as well as a few books that the members published themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are writers in the Society?

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Yeah. Most of them are writing diaries or autobiographies on their time in the organization.

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Some quit drinking, some learned to tailor, some became real good at calligraphy, and even I've learned to use a Kamera...

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Hah, we find it kind of funny, you see, had we managed to stay above ground, none of us would have ever had the time to learn any of those skills.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's all because you have a lot more free time now...

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Not only that, but we've also now got the mental space to think about taking on new things. Before we came here, we were constantly exhausted just trying to live.

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: With how the Duke and Mr. Dougier have organized our lives down here, though, all we need to do is think about the things that we want to do.

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: You never know what you may be good at until you give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: And while you're here, no matter what you do, you won't get judged for it. After all, there's no need to conform to societal expectations when you're already in jail.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is something like a safe space...

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's exactly right. After all, not everyone is good at fighting, or have the physical strength to do hard labor. The Society is exactly what some of us need.

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: And that's it, I just finished organizing this shelf as well, so feel free to check it out if you want. Just remember to put the books back after you're done!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we will!

talks.objective: Chat with the members of the Beret Society

dialogues.speaker: Aucelet
dialogues.text: Welcome to our gathering place. Is there anything you'd like me to explain to you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's okay, we're just taking a look around...

choices.text: You sound a bit like a Melusine guide.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: Well, that's not a bad comparison. It is my job to explain our amenities and benefits to our latest members.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: I'm sure Mr. Dougier has already explained some of it, but allow me to fill you in some more.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: Besides this space, which our members use to rest and relax, we also have an entertainment room, a fitness room, and a self-study room.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: These rooms are open to all of our members. We want everyone to be able to use their free time to the fullest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's pretty cool! Do you have a restaurant, too? If you did, you also wouldn't have to eat at the big cafeteria anymore...

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: Unfortunately, we don't. For matters like that, we still have to rely on His Grace.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: We started a collaboration with the Cafeteria a while back, though, so they'll let us borrow their kitchen to do some simple research into recipes and cooking.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You've really thought of everything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon can definitely see how it'd be easier to live your life if you had all this support.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: Yep, and that's exactly why Mr. Dougier founded the Society.

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: We all think we made the correct choice to join him.

choices.text: You sound a bit like a salesperson in a shop.

talks.objective: Chat with the members of the Beret Society

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: Hey, you there, newbie!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, hello? Are you talking to Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: Yep, I'm talking to you. Now, why don't you follow my lead and take a deep breath, before letting everything out like this?

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: Hah—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek!

choices.text: What are you doing?

response.speaker: Rigas
response.text: Haha, that's how I pump myself up every day. A lot of my friends have found it super useful, too.

response.speaker: Rigas
response.text: With one shout, you can release all the fatigue, resentment and unpleasantness from your lungs, and return to the day with all the optimism in the world!

response.speaker: Rigas
response.text: Why don't you also give it a try? I promise that it will work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: P—Paimon's gonna pass...

response.speaker: Rigas
response.text: Hahaha, feeling shy? That's alright. As long as you remember this trick, it will come in handy one day.

response.speaker: Rigas
response.text: Just remember to take a deep breath and let it all out if you find yourself at your wit's end.

choices.text: That was really loud.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, we've talked to everybody... It sure sounds like they're all pretty happy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That would explain why Wriothesley only had good things to say about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, it looks like they're starting to wrap up their conversation as well. Let's go over to them.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Of course, Your Grace. I will attend to those matters right away.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Okay, then I don't have anything else to add. Oh, you're back — what did you think about this place?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Now, note that your review will also affect my review of Dougier and the Society as a whole.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Wait. I didn't know they were also a part of the evaluation process...

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: It's all right with me, though. I'm pretty confident about our growth and activities.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks it's... pretty good?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't think anyone expected you to get a society going here of all places!

choices.text: Same here.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Ah, so it seems that you were able to get a sense of our vision and values. That's all I can ask for, really.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The prisoners here all have very different personalities and psychological needs.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Our needs are like violent beasts. If we can't face them properly, they'll grow restless and enraged, causing pain and conflict.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But if we can placate them, they will lose their fangs, and even be converted into fuel for far nobler pursuits.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Which is why in my opinion, learning to reconcile with oneself is the first step on the path to redemption.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: You've hit the nail on the head, Your Grace. Before I founded the Society, I had met too many people who could not come to terms with themselves...

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: And I'm sure that a part of your support is rooted in your desire to help those people find their way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon thought everyone was enjoying life just fine working and fighting...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Of course, that lifestyle is more than enough for some people in the Fortress. For others, though, they would just be useless distractions.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Speaking of fightin'... I'm not sure if you knew this, but even His Grace sometimes fights in the ring.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whaaat!? You fight in the ring, too? Wearing those hi-tech boxing gloves of yours...?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I almost never need them.

choices.text: Almost never, you say...

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: Ah...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, isn't that the guy who lost his hat? Did you come here to relax, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's wrong? Did you forget about us already?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Are you feeling alright? You are looking a little pale.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: N—No, I'm fine... Thank you for helping me get my hat back.

response.speaker: Faissolle
response.text: I... I'm sorry, but I've got to go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's still as weird as before... Paimon's kinda used to it by now, though.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Dougier, do you know what's up with him?

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Hmm, I'm also not too sure about that. As far as I recall, he's always been a little strange. I'll check up on him later.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: After all, it's my responsibility as the leader to make sure that no one falls through the cracks.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: We'll leave him to you, then. Hmm... Where were we before we got sidetracked?

choices.text: Something about useless distractions.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Oh, right, about that. You might have thought that I was joking, but in a place like that, everyone will use everything in their power to win.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And when emotions runs high, things often spiral out of control. That'd be when I'd need to pull out my gloves to maintain order.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Sometimes, you might need more than just gloves as well... This pair of handcuffs has also come in handy quite a number of times.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: ...Oops.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, isn't that that awful gem? You're still carrying it with you?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yeah, I kept it on me because of its special qualities. It won't affect me as long as I don't let it come into contact with my skin.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Go on, you guys, pick up the item for His Grace, would you?

response.speaker: Aucelet
response.text: Y—Yes, right away.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: That gem shines with quite the dazzling light. I hope it hasn't been damaged. Your Grace, please let me know if there's something wrong with it now.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hmm, it still looks good to me. Say, Dougier, have you ever seen a gem like this?

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Never, Your Grace. Don't think I've ever been rich enough to afford this kind of thing.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hahaha, I guess that's fair.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: We've already gone over most of the things that I wanted to talk about, so let's wrap up for the day. The Traveler also has some other plans, after all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Got it, Your Grace. Take care, everyone. I'll take you to the exit.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Traveler, Paimon, it was an honor. I'm sure everyone would love it if you were to visit again. That goes for you as well, Your Grace — we wish you all the best in endeavors.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Mm, and same to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon doesn't think we made any plans for the rest of the day... Why did you lie to him?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Well, what's your opinion of the Society now that you've taken a look around their headquarters?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon thinks it's pretty chill. Weren't you complimenting them the entire time as well?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't remember exactly what you said, but wasn't it something along the lines of encouraging people to embrace their new lives with optimism?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's only one potential problem. If the Society does too good of a job managing and rehabilitating its members, you may be soon out of a job...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Haha, that is certainly a possibility.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But at this point in time, they are still reducing my workload by managing and rehabilitating prisoners in my stead.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I wanted to see just how much they've managed to accomplish, and also get a sense of Dougier's plans for the future.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I arranged for a meeting out of curiosity, but then... I noticed some faint hints of dissonance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dissonance?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: #I'm sure {NICKNAME} has sensed it, too.

choices.text: It's a bit hard to put it into words...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: As expected, you also picked up on it.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The whole truth is a bit complicated, so I'll explain everything to you later. I can tell you right now, though, that this was an unexpected turn of events...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I had hoped to take care of it in secret, but now, a confrontation may no longer be avoidable. It's hard to predict what might happen next.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh? You've completely lost Paimon...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Why don't you take this opportunity to check back on the gathering place? Just tell them you left something of yours there by accident.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: If my hypothesis is correct, Dougier should already have left...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And with his watchful eye removed, you may well get a very different reception from the members.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... Can't you just tell us exactly what to expect?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm just following the most popular playbook in Fontaine. Investigate, obtain evidence, and then use the truth to render judgment...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's been so long since I got to watch a performance at Opera Epiclese that I've even begun to miss it.

choices.text: I'll trust you for now.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'll explain everything to you later. But right now, we need to seize this opportunity.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Find out what you can from them now, while they're all in one place. We might not get another chance like this anytime soon.

choices.text: I'll take this as another one of your jokes.
But there's something off about that place.
Something about boxing gloves.
So... instead...
It seems alright... on the surface.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Ah... Yeah, you're right. By themselves, our resources probably don't feel like much.

talks.objective: Return to the Beret Society's gathering place

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, it's just as Wriothesley said... Seems like Dougier's no longer here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You said you felt there was something off about this place, right? So let's see if we can feel something out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon will do her best to help!

choices.text: Uhh... I also don't know where to start.

response.speaker: Boulmier
response.text: Wait, you guys are...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're really sorry, we just realized that we'd lost something, and we figured we might have left it here by accident! We'll be on our way as soon as we find it.

response.speaker: Boulmier
response.text: O—Okay...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did anyone see a glass bottle by any chance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nobody?

choices.text: It was about the size of my hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay, there's no need to be nervous! It's not like we lost a whole bag of Mora or anything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll just look for it ourselves if none of you caught a glimpse of it. We're not gonna tell Wriothesley anything, don't worry.

response.speaker: Rigas
response.text: I—I'll go find Mr. Dougier...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need! We're just looking for something. Why does he have to know?

choices.text: (This is incredibly suspicious.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can look around for it, yeah?

response.speaker: Boulmier
response.text: Uh...

choices.text: (Feels like they're all... terrified of something.)
I was using it to store some spice powder.
Let's see if we can strike up a conversation.

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you still organizing the bookshelves?

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Yeah, and, I'm sorry, but... you can't check out the books right now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We weren't thinking about that to begin with! But weren't you super friendly just a moment ago?

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: S—Sorry...

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hello? Anyone home?

dialogues.speaker: Aucelet
dialogues.text: Hello... How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you give us that run-down again?

dialogues.speaker: Aucelet
dialogues.text: The Beret Society offers a variety of resources and benefits to its members, and... Uh... I mean, you've already heard my spiel. I don't know anything beyond what I've already told you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't know anything?

dialogues.speaker: Aucelet
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry, that's not what I meant... It's just... There's nothing more I can tell you.

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heeeey, big guy!

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: Wh—What do you want...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't this how you greeted us earlier? Take a deep breath, and let it all out...

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, that's right, you sure are a fast learner...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where did your optimism go?

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: Uh, I ate something earlier, so I'm falling into a bit of a food coma, and uh... I mean, not everyone can be super upbeat all the time, right?

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: You're looking for something, you said? I didn't see it, but it should be somewhere nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: S—Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: You really can't check them out... Please understand...

dialogues.speaker: Aucelet
dialogues.text: Please... Please just leave me alone...

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: I didn't see it... Why don't you try to look for it somewhere else?

talks.objective: Talk to the members of the Beret Society again

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. How were things at their headquarters?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was as if they had all turned into completely different people...

choices.text: They all clammed up.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Hmm, that would prove my suspicions.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The "dissonance" I mentioned earlier was precisely that fleeting moment of fear behind the cheerful facade.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Like that one guy we found hiding in the box.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, he was acting super scared too when we saw him at the gathering place!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Actually, hasn't he just been acting super paranoid since we first met?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And that is precisely why I took his hat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so the one who started it all was...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It was you all along!

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's because I wanted to figure out what's really going on.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I don't believe any of Dougier's talk about unstable mental states.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How long have you been investigating this?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Not too long. Dougier made very elaborate preparations for my visit, but I don't know... it almost feels like the performance was too elaborate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, but if you think something's wrong, why don't you just take the whole Society into custody?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aren't you the Duke? You can do whatever you want in this place.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Haha, maybe you're actually a better fit for the position than I am. Just give me the word, and I'll hand you the cuffs.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: In all seriousness, however, cuffs and the like should be used sparingly. They're mostly for show.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Everything I do is on display. The way people see me act determines the kind of world I can create down here.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And I've always striven to appear fair and reasonable to the people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... That sounds a bit deep. Paimon's not sure she got all of it...

choices.text: The Duke's actions will set the tone.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yeah, you've hit the nail on the head. I have to lead by example if I want to maintain expectations of justice and order.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And that's why even though Dougier had already let a few things slip, I didn't want to turn on him without irrefutable evidence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright. So you're saying, Dougier has figured out some way to control the members of his society...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And even though the members are acting all optimistic and motivated, it's all just a show.

choices.text: I doubt it's that simple.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Indeed. He certainly seems to be using some coercive methods to turn his members into the most upbeat and motivated group of people you've ever seen. But that won't turn out well in the long run.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I have some faith, though, that some of the members understood the hint I gave during our visit.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The line has been set, and it's quite likely that a fish will bite.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Fish? Bite?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Let's give them some time. My guards will need it to finish their investigation, too.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You can find me in my office when the time comes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't just leave before you've explained everything to Paimon! Heeeey!

choices.text: I feel like we're still missing something.
The Duke's values will be emulated by the people.
They were all acting super scared.

talks.objective: Meet up with Wriothesley as you agreed

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: I apologize for my lack of composure. These two are the guests that came with you to our gathering place, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know us?

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Yes, my lover Faissolle told me all about you. Please help us, Your Grace, he's in great danger right now...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Slow down, take a deep breath, and start from the top. What happened at the Society?

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Your Grace, I will try... I think I should start from when you saw Faissolle last.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean, when we saw him at the gathering place?

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Yes, he fled immediately, but many members are hot on his heels.

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Thankfully, he still managed to meet up with me, and explain everything that had happened.

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Now that he's lost Dougier's trust, what awaits him is agonizing "censure."

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Censure?

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Censure is Dougier's method of establishing control, as well as the thing we all fear the most.

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Rather than listening to me explain what it is, Your Grace, please just let me show it to you...

dialogues.speaker: Avice
dialogues.text: Every secret may be found within—

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Ah, here you are. I was wondering where you had run off to in such a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: Please excuse us, Your Grace. It was never our intention to disturb you like this. You see, Avice's mental state has been rather unstable ever since she arrived at the Fortress...

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: She rambles often, and has hallucinations. It may be best to dismiss her babbling as random gibberish.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I don't recall hearing a knock, or giving permission for you to come in.

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: My apologies. I merely did not wish for Your Grace to be alarmed. Had I not been so focused on recovering her, I would have followed all the rules of etiquette to the letter. So, please forgive my discourtesy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hah, like we'd believe you!

choices.text: We know exactly what you're thinking.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Please, there's no need to be upset. It's only natural to want to side with the poor, sick girl, but I know His Grace to be a reasonable man.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Well then, what if the reasonable man wants to hear the lunatic out?

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: That would be perfectly fine with me. Oh, and just so you know, we've also found the missing Mr. Faissolle. I have no idea why he was so upset about losing his hat, really.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Thankfully, he has already returned to his senses. We've brought him back to our place, so there's no need to worry.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: I'm sorry, Your Grace... I don't have anything more to say.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: This is what you're afraid of, correct? You can tell me everything. I'll do all I can for you.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: I've never seen that thing in my life.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can do it, Avice.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Your Grace, I don't think there's anything else she would like to say. Pressuring her will not get you anywhere.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's alright, Avice. As long as you tell me what it is that you're terrified of...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: No matter what it is, it will no longer be able to hurt you. I swear this on my name and honor as the Duke.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Your Grace... *sigh* Forget it. I'll keep my mouth shut. I've already said everything I could say about the matter.

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: I'm sorry, Your Grace, but I really don't have anything more to say. Please... don't press me further.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... why?

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: In that case, Avice and I will be off. Once again, please accept my apologies for disturbing your peaceful evening, Your Grace.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Miss Avice, please show me your head. That is an order.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Wriothesley proceeds to examine Avice's head, but does not find anything suspicious.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: There's nothing there...

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Your Grace, I know you have long tired of my words, but please believe me when I say you've merely let your worries get to your head.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: The Society has never caused trouble for you or any of the guards at the Fortress. We've spent all of our time working hard and trying to lead better lives.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Why are you doing everything in your power to prove our "guilt"? What's wrong with the current state of affairs?

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: I'll do anything for you as long as you give me the word. Why are you so intent on getting rid of someone who's been unfalteringly loyal?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Your words bore me. You know the consequences if I find you to be lying.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Everything that I do, I do for the Fortress of Meropide. But Your Grace is welcome to visit us anytime to confirm the true intent of our activities.

response.speaker: Dougier
response.text: Alright, Avice, let's head back.

choices.text: You've got some nerve, showing your face here.
Indeed, like we'd believe you.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I have an idea, but...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What a coincidence. So do I.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it? Tell Paimon about it!

choices.text: Avice didn't take off her hat to draw attention to her head.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You mean... this thing?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, she handed a key piece of evidence over to us without Dougier noticing.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That would mean that Avice didn't stay silent out of fear. She stayed silent because she'd already given us what we needed.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Let me take a look.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Wriothesley tinkers with the hair clip for a brief moment.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I managed to remove this from the hair clip. It's long, slender, and conical, it's hollow on the inside, and looks something like a cross between a nail and a thorn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon's lost again...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Let's see... What if we do this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what are you doing... Wait, some kind of dark liquid is leaking out of the gem...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And... some of it has been absorbed by this thorny-looking thing...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The gem is used as a container for a type of liquid.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You've probably heard before that water is filled with the strongest emotions of humanity.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: With that in mind, this liquid is probably a highly concentrated solution of "fear."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so that's why even touching it will make you remember unpleasant things!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, with this infused thorn...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Dougier would be able to "censure" others. I can only imagine how it would feel to have this directly injected into your brain...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The moment it hits you... would be like being flooded with all the terrors you've ever experienced in your life.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Agony, desolation, and an overwhelming sense of despair... No wonder they're all so terrified of it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... was the hat meant to cover up their wounds?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That might not even be all. Let's go get them right away.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: We can't let Dougier escape with all of the evidence.

choices.text: She did so to remove her hair clip.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh, here you are. Did you manage to land a lucky pull on the Welfare Meals tonight?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's just get straight to the point! Has anything else happened with the Society?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Patience, Paimon. Even as the situation continues to brew, we still need to make sense of what we've learned so far, and go over any sticking points.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'm actually still thinking about the first thing that came to my mind when I noticed something amiss. Namely:

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Why didn't anyone come to me about it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's a good point! Could whatever they're afraid of be so powerful that even you won't be able to do anything about it?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: But even if such a thing existed, how could they be so sure without checking with me first?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It'd be one thing if it was just one or two people, but it seems like everyone's convinced that I won't be able to help.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Which leads me to believe that it's more likely that they think I just wouldn't care to help them.

choices.text: Because you instigated Dougier in the first place?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yes, something like that. Dougier must have told them something to make them think I won't take their side.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So it became imperative for me to refute that, and prove my true stance.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Of course, I had originally planned to do this in a more covert way, but I had to improvise when you identified the guy who'd lost his hat with everyone present.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: There was no way to keep our investigation a secret after that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That makes sense... Wait, then does that mean it was all Paimon's fault?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Now that you mention it...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The last thing that guy wanted was for Dougier to find out that he'd lost it. He would've never brought the matter up on his own.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But now, not only has Dougier found out that he'd lost his hat, he's also realized that we were the ones who found it...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That likely set his internal alarms off all at once.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The hats must be hiding something...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yes, that's the conclusion I came to as well. It's the only thing that could explain the fear.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: If we didn't act right then and there, Dougier would probably come up with some other way to hide the truth, and we'd be back to square one.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So after giving the matter some thought, I tossed that black gem onto the ground.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I must say, I was pretty satisfied with the results.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, so you did that on purpose!?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Yes, that's right. Of course, that box was discovered as a part of our investigation of the Society from the very beginning.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I had no way to know if any of the members had actually seen the gem before, but since I had to do something, I decided to gamble.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So that's the "hint" you were talking about earlier.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Right, and I said back there that I had no idea what the gem represented. That should've been enough to let people know that it's still early days for my investigation.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And since I was traveling with you, heroes who have never turned a blind eye to evil and injustice...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: They would also understand that we're here to help, rather than to tolerate or uphold the status quo.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You used us as a part of your plan, too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So that's why you wanted us to come along.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: My apologies. There was no time and quite a lot to explain, so I figured it might be easier to just let you see a few things for yourselves.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But I can assure you that I've now told you everything there is to know.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Of course, you're under no obligation, but I would really appreciate it if you could continue to lend me your support and help me figure out the true secret behind the Society.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Would you be willing to lend me your support?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, but Paimon's still mad at you...

choices.text: Sure, if all you need is some help planning.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: You have my thanks.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Now, there are still two outstanding matters in our investigation. The first is the secret of the hats.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I've examined one before. There was nothing suspicious about the item itself.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The other is the true purpose of the black gem. We haven't been able to get anything out of anyone with actual knowledge of it.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It's my hope that a brave fish will take my bait, and venture outside of their dark and murky pool.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'll put some music on while we wait.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You spend some time waiting in Wriothesley's office...

response.speaker: Avice
response.text: ...Excuse me, Your Grace, but may I come in? I'm afraid that someone's been following me.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Please do.

choices.text: Sure, if I just need to fight them off.
Because you've been working with Dougier all along?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh, just what's up with that guy!? He makes Paimon really, really mad!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should have shown him his place!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sooner or later, all will pay the price for their arrogance.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: He must have been well-prepared for this exact scenario, or he wouldn't have dared to be so openly hostile — all the more reason for us to be patient.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: The entire Society are his hostages. His subordinates would definitely react if he were taken into custody.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: And that's why he dared to bare his fangs right in front of me.

choices.text: One thing's for sure, we won't let him get away with this.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: The true secret of the Society is neither on the hat, nor on the members' heads.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Dougier probably knew this from the very beginning, which is why he didn't panic.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: However, if we were to look at the rules, it would also seem like the head has to be the place where they're keeping all of their secrets.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, none of this makes sense to Paimon, either... What are they trying to hide?

choices.text: So now, our biggest problem is...

dialogues.speaker: Examine Books
dialogues.text: (There's a good variety of books here, and it also looks like the selection is regularly updated. If nothing else, one can definitely find something here with which to pass the time.)

dialogues.speaker: Examine Books
dialogues.text: (A member's diary is also displayed among the books. It was probably included for recruitment purposes.)

dialogues.speaker: Boulmier
dialogues.text: Please check out as many books as you may like. Just don't forget to return them to their proper places once you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Aucelet
dialogues.text: Life at the Society is rich and fulfilling. We all enjoy it immensely.

dialogues.speaker: Rigas
dialogues.text: There's no need to be embarrassed about it! Just embrace your emotions, and freely express it for all to hear!

dialogues.speaker: Dougier
dialogues.text: The Society is planning to host another event soon. We haven't had many new recruits recently, so...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Ah, the one you mentioned to me before? The idea is sound, but I still have some concerns about the specifics...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... what are you gonna do?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Good question, what should I do... Hmm, maybe I'll drop by the Ring and sign myself up for a fight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so you're really just gonna make us work while you slack off!?

dialogues.speaker: Wolsey
dialogues.text: Hmm... I should probably always keep a few Super Deluxe Welfare Meals in stock.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, Paimon sees what you meant now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like they really don't want to talk to us, so let's just head back...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's finally evening... Wriothesley's probably wrapped up his investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has no idea what that guy's thinking... Let's just go find him and ask him what he's really up to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (The hats are definitely being used to hide a secret. But there's nothing wrong with the hats themselves...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But if there's nothing on her head, why did Avice feel the need to remove her hat?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (From the way Dougier acted, he must have known from the beginning that we wouldn't be able to find any evidence.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I need to think about this a bit more... Just what is Dougier trying to hide?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I can't seem to make a connection here.)
